project.description: RFC 0065 layer 3, RFC 0066 — the theme design core: the design vocabularies an app declares and a theme fills, one sub-module per kind. Nothing here is a studio; anything that serves a JS app can bind a palette. The first sub-module is colour (the global palette); scales, typography and the rest arrive as their own sub-modules as the semantic tree grows (RFC 0066 Episode 2).
